title: commercial opportunities - u.s. embassy in paraguay
paragraphs: in order to promote international trade and stimulate trade contact between the united states of america and paraguay, the united states embassy commercial office in asunción, paraguay, offers a variety of free services to help us and paraguayan companies wish to establish contacts or improve their business contacts with companies from one country or another. although the main mission of the commercial office of this embassy is the promotion of united states products and services abroad, every effort is made to respond to requirements of other commercial information. to learn more about investment opportunities in paraguay get in touch with the commercial office at the u.s. embassy in asunción: embassy phone: (+59521) 248 3000 email: commercialasuncion@state.gov or visit the website of the chamber of commerce paraguayan american
